Scenario fixture: aria-attribute-conformance (RGAA 8.2.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form aac_case_NN. Expected outcomes follow the W3C validator 26.9.27: every FAIL case is an error there, every PASS case is not. Hidden content is checked too.

01 — FAIL: misspelt attribute name aria-labeledby
Send

03 — FAIL: aria-level="0", out of range

04 — FAIL: aria-pressed on a link

1

MoreContent
07 — FAIL: aria-label on a div with no role
Menu

09 — FAIL: aria-checked on a native checkbox, even when it agrees
10 — FAIL: aria-disabled="false" on a disabled button

E. Hidden content (FAIL)

Option
